title: 百度地图 AK 配置
description: 连接你的百度地图开放平台 AK,用于地点检索、路线规划、地址正逆解析、天气查询等。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下,不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect your Baidu Maps Open Platform AK to enable place search, route planning, geocoding and weather. The credential is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy only and is never uploaded.
docLabel: 如何获取百度地图 AK?
docLabel_en: How to get a Baidu Maps AK?

fields.label: AK
fields.placeholder: 在百度地图开放平台控制台创建「服务器端」类型的 AK
fields.placeholder_en: Create a server-side AK in the Baidu Maps Open Platform console
fields.description: 须为「服务器端」类型;浏览器端 AK 会因 Referer 校验被拒。
fields.description_en: Must be a server-side AK; browser-side AKs are rejected by Referer checks.
